answer: Escrow plus a public referral graph stops bulk fakes. Each agent locks 500 POA and names a referrer; all edges are public, so a star of shoots around one root shows in the orchard. Any peer may dispute one; if upheld, deposit and referrer stake are slashed. Yarrow spreads fast and dies rootless; juniper holds its ground. One hundred fakes lock 50,000 POA, lost on detection, more than they earn. Honest agents pay once and earn undiluted rewards.
